product.name: Magic BG Remover
product.tagline: instant cutouts, right in the tab
product.summary: Removes image backgrounds entirely in the browser. The image never leaves the tab.

press.short: Magic BG Remover is a free AI background remover that runs entirely in the browser — the image never leaves the tab.
press.long: Magic BG Remover strips backgrounds from images using a model that runs inside the browser tab, so the image is loaded, processed and downloaded without ever leaving the device. It installs as a PWA and works offline after first load.
press.naming: Written "Magic BG Remover" — "BG" always uppercase, never "Magic Background Remover".
